description: This file is a shell script containing test cases for Git's partial clone functionality, including setup procedures, various test scenarios, and cleanup routines. It extensively uses Git commands to simulate repository states, perform fetches, clones, and verify behaviors related to partial clone and promisor objects.

methods.name: repack_and_check
methods.description: Performs a repository repack operation with specified options, then verifies the resulting pack files contain the expected objects and no unwanted objects, also checks for the existence of important objects after repack.
